## Your Account Features  
### SmartSaver Highlights
✓ **Competitive Interest:** 4.50%–4.80% AER
✓ **Variable Rate:** Tracks Bank of England + 2.5% margin
✓ **No Monthly Fees:** Keep your money longer
✓ **Easy Access:** Withdraw anytime, no penalties
✓ **Monthly Interest:** Paid every month
